Address: 401 S Frio St, San Antonio, TX 78207

Phone: 12102078970

San Antonio Municipal Court is a trial court serving the residents of Bexar County, Texas. The courthouse was established in 1896. The court is also known as the court of record and it is operating as a City of San Antonio judicial branch. The mission is to commit justice in a fair, efficient and timely manner. It has jurisdiction over criminal, civil, juvenile traffic, and vehicle matters. The court provides many services that are available in-person, via mail or online. The court rules and procedures must be followed by every person that visits the court. Proper dressing is required in the courthouse.

How to search for case records?

San Antonio MunicipalCourt case search for records can be found online using https://www.municipalonlinepayments.com/sanantoniotx/court/search. The court maintains all the records online, in files, or a database. The case search can be done using the following ways:

  • Search by Case Number
  • Search by Traffic or Citation Number
  • Search by Name
  • Search by Driver’s License Number

After entering the data, the case information will come. This website will only show those records information that is publicly available. The sealed records are not available for the viewing of the public. Some records are unavailable; if the information does not come, the case records will be removed or confidential and cannot be displayed online. You have to mail a record request form to https://www.sa.gov/Directory/Departments/CE/Open-Records-Request for these types of records. Enter your name, address, email address, date range and subject matters in the form. The court will decide whether to provide you with the information or not. You had to pay the mandatory fees for each per-page copy of the record if you need the records certified copies.

How to make a payment?

San Antonio MunicipalCourt payments can be made in the following ways:

· In-Person

A person can pay for tickets and fines by visiting the court during regular court hours and paying in cash, checks, or with a card at the court payment window. Take your ticket and citation number with you when you come for payment. Service charges will be applied if you make a payment with a credit card.

· Online

Online payments can be made using https://www.municipalonlinepayments.com/sanantoniotx/court/search.Look up your case by using the name, case, driver’s license and citation number. After this, your case with the amount of the fine will be displayed. Pay using any online method. A convenience fee will be applied during this process.

· Mail

A Person can send a certified check or money order to the court's mailing address; San Antonio Municipal Court 401 S. Frio St., San Antonio, TX 78207. Cash or personal checks are not acceptable in the mail; only certified checks or money orders are accepted. Remember to write your citation, name, case number, and account number when you send the payment, and mail the amount in a self-addressed, stamped envelope if you want a receipt.

How can I resolve my traffic tickets?

San Antonio Municipal Court traffic division handles all traffic and vehicle violation matters. The violation includes accidents, speeding, using a mobile phone during driving, violating traffic signals and traffic rules and many more. You can receive a citation after some days of getting the traffic ticket. If the ticket contains a mandatory appearance, then you have to appear on the schedule. If the court does not contain mandatory appearance, then many options are available that are:

  • Pay the full fine on the time
  • Appear before the judge
  • Enter and send a plea to the court
  • Apply for a driver safety course or deferred disposition

How many pleas can be sent to the court?

San Antonio Municipal Court plea options are available for some traffic tickets, parking and non-traffic cases. Two types of pleas are available which are:

· Plea of guilty

If you are guilty of your actions then write this plea. After sending it the court will review your plea and send you the amount of the fine and there is no need to appear in court. You can also file a notice of appeal in this case.

· Plea of not guilty

If you are not guilty of your act, then write this plea. The court will give you a schedule and you have to appear on that day with your proof of innocence.

What happens in the cases of criminal matters?

San Antonio Municipal Court criminal court handles all crime-related matters that include murder, kidnapping etc. It is compulsory to appear before a judge in criminal matters. You can write a plea before appearing in court. The judge recommend you deferred disposition with or without disposition.

The juvenile court provides which types of services?

San Antonio Municipal Court juvenile court handles matters in which a minor age person is involved. The matters include cases in which a child is neglected or abused by their guardian and then the court will protect them. The court also handles cases in which the minor does a violation that is considered to be a crime if it is done by the adult. You can solve juvenile matters by appearing before the judge and entering any plea. If the juvenile is found guilty then the judge will provide many case management program information that includes drug programs, parent engagements, counseling services, café college, curriculum-based and probation programs. Choose any one program and pay the fees and fines.

How can I apply for a birth certificate?

San Antonio Municipal Court birth certificate can be obtained in person or by mail from the city clerk's vital records division office. You can also receive it online via Vital Check or the Texas Department of State Health Services. You can apply for the certificate by filling out the form in the office or downloading the form online, filling it and mailing it to the Office of the City Clerk Vital Records Division 719 S. Santa Rosa San Antonio, Texas 78204. You had to submit a valid ID with the amount of the certificate. $23 per copy is the fee for the birth certificate and the shipping cost is $14.50. If you apply online then you had to make an account at https://www.vitalchek.com/order_status_signon.aspx and upload your documents and pay the fees.

FAQ:

What happens if I do not pay a traffic fine on time?

If you do not pay traffic fines on time then your license will be suspended, extra fines will be added to the previous one and in serious cases, warrants will be issued against you.

Does this court handle domestic violence matters?

Yes, this court handles domestic violence-related matters. The mission of this department is to facilitate Class C misdemeanor violence cases and provide safety to every person that faces domestic violence.
